, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly revised the earliest appearance of fish to ~240–250 million years ago, which is far too recent (fish originate in the Cambrian/Ordovician, ~530–450+ million years ago). This factual error contradicts earlier findings and would wrongly make reptiles (~312+ mya) seem older than fish, leading to an incorrect conclusion.
